caseName: Wright El v. Court of Gen. Sessions of S.C.
caseNameFull: Terrence WRIGHT EL v. COURT OF GENERAL SESSIONS OF SOUTH CAROLINA, CHARLESTON COUNTY

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner to leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied, and petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit dismissed. See Rule 39.8.
